name: Biogen
description: Biogen sells drugs for neurological and rare diseases, led by multiple sclerosis (MS) medicines (41 percent of 2025 revenue, shrinking 7 percent a year as older drugs lose exclusivity) and Spinraza for spinal muscular atrophy. A big part of its revenue is not its own product sales: $1.86 billion (19 percent) comes from anti-CD20 programs, its collaboration revenue from Genentech, and $0.73 billion from contract manufacturing, royalties and other, including making batches of the Alzheimer's drug Leqembi for partner Eisai. Biogen books only its 50 percent share of Leqembi sales, which is small so far ($178 million of revenue in 2025). It reports one segment and pays no dividend.

gics.note: Conventional filing: Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (read 2026-09-30) gives sector Health Care and sub-industry Biotechnology; industry group and industry not listed there, left null. SEC SIC 2836.

hq.note: Per Wikipedia List of S&P 500 companies

employees.note: Approximately 7,500 employees worldwide: about 4,200 in the US and 3,300 in foreign countries (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Multiple Sclerosis products
businessLines.how: Sells branded injectable and oral MS drugs to patients and health systems via insurers and distributors on recurring prescriptions; revenue declines as patents expire and generics and biosimilars arrive.
businessLines.description: TECFIDERA and VUMERITY (fumarates, $1,426.5M), AVONEX and PLEGRIDY (interferons, $945.6M), TYSABRI ($1,665.4M) and FAMPYRA.

revenue.note: Net product revenue; FY2024 4,349.8 (-7.1%); FY2023 4,661.9. US 2,372.5; rest of world 1,666.4. TECFIDERA 679.7 (vs 967.1), VUMERITY 746.8, AVONEX 695.5, PLEGRIDY 250.1, TYSABRI 1,665.4 (a TYSABRI biosimilar was approved in the US and EU in 2023).

businessLines.revenueNote: Net product revenue; FY2024 4,349.8 (-7.1%); FY2023 4,661.9. US 2,372.5; rest of world 1,666.4. TECFIDERA 679.7 (vs 967.1), VUMERITY 746.8, AVONEX 695.5, PLEGRIDY 250.1, TYSABRI 1,665.4 (a TYSABRI biosimilar was approved in the US and EU in 2023).

businessLines.name: Rare disease products
businessLines.how: Very high price per patient on chronic treatment for small patient populations, billed to insurers and health systems; Spinraza is a repeated intrathecal injection.
businessLines.description: SPINRAZA (spinal muscular atrophy, $1,546.8M), SKYCLARYS (Friedreich's ataxia, $520.5M) and QALSODY (SOD1-ALS, $86.9M).

businessLines.name: Anti-CD20 therapeutic programs (Genentech collaboration)
businessLines.how: Biogen receives a share of profits and royalties on sales made by its partner, not its own product sales, so it carries almost no selling cost on this revenue.
businessLines.description: Revenue from Biogen's collaboration arrangements on anti-CD20 therapies with Genentech; the 10-K notes that RITUXAN biosimilar competition has cut Biogen's pre-tax profits from the arrangements.

businessLines.name: Biosimilars
businessLines.how: Sells lower-priced copies of other companies' biologic drugs to European health systems, mostly through tenders, at thinner margins than its own brands.
businessLines.description: BENEPALI ($453.2M), IMRALDI ($190.2M), FLIXABI ($52.6M), BYOOVIZ ($32.4M), TOFIDENCE ($0.7M); almost all sold outside the US.

businessLines.name: Contract manufacturing, royalty and other revenue
businessLines.how: Cost-plus fees for manufacturing drug for partners, plus royalty income on licensed products.
businessLines.description: Contract manufacturing for strategic customers (including LEQEMBI batches for Eisai), royalties and other.

revenue.note: FY2024 652.6 (+12.3%); contract manufacturing revenue 679.4 vs 592.1; the 10-K notes LEQEMBI batches carry lower margins.

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2024 652.6 (+12.3%); contract manufacturing revenue 679.4 vs 592.1; the 10-K notes LEQEMBI batches carry lower margins.

businessLines.name: Alzheimer's collaboration revenue (LEQEMBI) and other products
businessLines.how: On Leqembi Biogen books half the product revenue and cost of sales through collaboration accounting; ZURZUVAE (postpartum depression) is sold on prescription.
businessLines.description: Biogen's 50.0% share of LEQEMBI product revenue and cost of sales (Eisai collaboration); other product revenue includes ZURZUVAE ($195.1M), FUMADERM and ADUHELM.

revenue.note: Sum of Alzheimer's collaboration revenue 177.7 (vs 59.9 in 2024) and other product revenue 197.2 (vs 82.5)
